set.statement: Rhiza installs with go install or from release binaries published for each release, an annotated version tag

An annotated v* tag (the one tools/release cut pushes) runs a GitHub Actions release job that builds rhiza with GoReleaser for linux and darwin on amd64 and arm64 and publishes the archives and a checksums file to a GitHub release; a lightweight v* tag, such as publishing a major's draft release makes, publishes nothing
The release job for an annotated v* tag publishes a GitHub build-provenance attestation for every archive, so gh attestation verify <archive> --repo dphaener/rhiza succeeds on a downloaded release

Every release (an annotated v* tag) publishes manifest.json beside its archives: channel (release), version, commit, and for each os/arch the archive URL and sha256, so releases/latest/download/manifest.json always names the newest release
